parsedVerdict.reasoning: This unit is one file, src/delivery/delivery.module.ts. It is the NestJS composition root for the delivery feature. It registers the TypeORM entities Order and Deliveryman, the two controllers (DeliverymanController and OrdersController), and the services and repositories for the deliveryman and orders sub-areas. Deliverymen and orders belong to the same delivery concern, and AddOrderToDeliverymanService and UpdateDeliverymansOrdersService show that the two sub-areas are tied together. The file holds no business rules or invariants, so nothing is duplicated. It also bypasses no module abstraction: it only wires providers, which is what a module file is for. The only inconsistency is cosmetic. The Deliveryman import uses an absolute path ('src/delivery/__models__/deliveryman.model') while Order uses a relative one ('./__models__/orders.model'). Two service files also lack the .service.ts suffix. None of this breaks cohesion or the module boundary.
